message:
Yen receipts now show `Paid ¥500 by card`, and all 18 tests pass.

The cause is in the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. That file belongs to another team, so I left it alone. I fixed it inside `src/payments/receipt.js` instead, where yen is now formatted as whole units and every other currency still goes through `formatMoney`.

The same bug still affects anything else that calls `formatMoney` with JPY, such as invoices, the cart and admin. The better fix is in `money.js`, so you may want to tell the team that owns it.
